cases.name: hush-file-write
cases.doc: KNOWN DIVERGENCE: under -q (*hush* = true), `pr` to a FILE stream still writes on shen-cl/shen-go/ShenScript, but is SILENCED (zero-byte file) on shen-lua/shen-rust. This is a real, documented behavioural difference in how *hush* gates file-stream output. Encoded as an xfail-style expectation table: each impl must land in its documented bucket; the run reports DIVERGE, never a hard agreement FAILURE. Practical consequence: omit -q when driving shen-lua/shen-rust if you need `pr` to reach a file (this is why Bifrost's normal eval/script templates for those two do NOT pass -q).
